initialExam.title: BHEL Engineer Trainee 2026
initialExam.description: BHEL recruits Engineer Trainees through GATE score for power plant equipment manufacturing and heavy engineering projects across India.
initialExam.syllabus: Based on GATE syllabus of respective engineering branch.
initialExam.examPattern: GATE Score (85%) + Interview (15%). No separate written test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: GATE Score Shortlisting → Interview → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Engineer Trainee in BHEL for power equipment manufacturing
initialExam.careerGrowth: ET → Engineer → Senior Engineer → DGM → GM → ED → CMD.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit bhel.com 2. Register 3. Enter GATE details 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, PF, Gratuity, Township accommodation
